iron__from__ice_: Walter Ice was a fisherman in Northwick until the posters went up. He came to S-F7 with a pocket Bible with a hole in it, and within a day the whole bay knew that he is superstitious about the number three.
Walter Ice's transfer to the role of sniper was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else.

Walter Ice found a clean patch on the table and put his bread on it. Someone immediately asked to borrow the patch. Day 3. Verdel Ridge fell to the Concord. Walter Ice watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Walter Ice had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Dorian "Whistle" Csllgaks crossed it, Walter Ice fired. Dorian "Whistle" Csllgaks was badly wounded.
The guns found S-F7. Walter Ice was dug out of a collapsed dugout with both legs pinned and carried back on a groundsheet.

Walter Ice lay on a stretcher under a canvas sheet and watched the orderlies carry men in and out. Nobody had time to talk. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Walter Ice helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
There was never a bed for Walter Ice, so the medics brought the hospital to him. Three days on a stretcher, and he walked back to S-F7 on his own feet.
Dawn watch. Walter Ice put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Dorian "Whistle" Csllgaks, grazed.
jamie_fxx1: After 5 days of war, S-S11 had a place for everything. On Day 6, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Matthias Fxx.

A one-eyed crow landed on the parapet above Matthias Fxx. The men named it the Parson and said it had chosen him. A letter from home found Matthias Fxx before the night shift. Matthias Fxx folded it small and kept it close.
Matthias Fxx stacked spare duckboards beside the junction. Within an hour, the stack had become a bench, a table and an argument.
ryder_miller11: "You're late," said the corporal when Cyril Miller arrived on Day 4. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."

Cyril Miller found a flower growing out of a sandbag. He did not tell anyone. He checks on it every morning. A letter from home found Cyril Miller before the night shift. Cyril Miller folded it small and kept it close.

A round came through a gap in the sandbags at S-F20 and grazed Cyril Miller's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Florian Monkey of the Concord (@autistic_monkey3). A letter from home found Cyril Miller before the night shift. Cyril Miller folded it small and kept it close. The Hegemony flag went up over Hill 304. Cyril Miller did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
Fever took hold of Cyril Miller overnight. The medics changed the dressing twice and then called for the bearers.
There was never a bed for Cyril Miller, so the medics brought the hospital to him. Three days on a stretcher, and he walked back to S-F20 on his own feet.
senkoo_sann0: Cyril "Mud" Sann unpacked a book with the last pages torn out at R-S8. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was.
Cyril "Mud" Sann's spoon vanished during supper. He scratched a mark into a replacement and began keeping a closer eye on the washing bucket.
A story about a goat passed through three dugouts and reached Cyril "Mud" Sann as a story about a general. The ending was the same.
